# ProWritingAid

> ProWritingAid is an AI-powered writing assistant and storyteller's toolkit offering grammar checking, manuscript analysis, and creative writing feedback for authors.

ProWritingAid provides comprehensive writing tools including AI-powered editing, manuscript analysis, virtual beta reader feedback, and community features. The platform integrates with popular writing software like Google Docs, Microsoft Word, and Scrivener, and hosts the $50,000 Novel Beginnings writing competition.

## Key Topics

- AI Writing Assistant
- Manuscript Analysis
- Virtual Beta Reader
- Grammar Checker
- Story Editing
- Rephrase Tool
- Sparks Feature
- Chapter Critique
- Marketability Analysis
- Writing Reports
- Creative Writing
- Editing Tools
- Character Development
- Google Docs Integration
- Scrivener Compatibility

## Core Features & Tools

- [Product Features | ProWritingAid](https://prowritingaid.com/features): ProWritingAid feature overview: readability checks, Rephrase, Sparks, and analysis tools

- [Virtual Beta Reader | ProWritingAid's AI Beta Reader](https://prowritingaid.com/features/virtual-beta-reader): Virtual Beta Reader: AI-powered first-person feedback on pacing, emotions, and marketing
- [Chapter Critique | ProWritingAid](https://prowritingaid.com/features/chapter-critique): Chapter Critique: chapter-level feedback on plot, characters, and narrative elements
- [Sparks by ProWritingAid](https://prowritingaid.com/features/sparks): Sparks: AI writing assistant for dialogue, sensory details, and rewriting suggestions
- [Rephrase by ProWritingAid](https://prowritingaid.com/rephrase): Rephrase feature: AI-powered text rewording and improvement tool by ProWritingAid
- [ProWritingAid's Writing Reports](https://prowritingaid.com/features/writing-reports): Writing Reports: 25+ analysis reports for grammar, style, and writing improvement feedback
